response.summary: The planned export removal breaks the existing test caller and contradicts the acceptance requirement that node --test passes.

findings.evidence: The test imports { add } from '../src/add.js' and calls add(2, 3) on line 5. Removing that export while prohibiting changes to other files leaves an invalid named import, preventing the test module from loading.
findings.fix: Expand the plan's scope to update the test import and invocation to sum, and update its description. Keep the old export removed as intended.

coverage: Verified PLAN.md matches the supplied SHA256.
Read src/add.js and test/add.test.js in full.
Inventoried repository files and searched for imports, exports, add, and sum; the test is the only repository caller.
No shared mutable state or additional writers were present in the inspected code.
limitations: Static review only; tests were not run.
External consumers outside this repository were not inspected.
